evals.prompt: Evaluate a new SaaS product concept for AI document processing, score 5 candidate features using RICE, and define the MVP scope.
evals.expected_output: The agent scores features using RICE, separates Must-have features from deferred scope, and outputs an MVP scoping document.
expectations: Feature backlog is scored using the RICE formula
MVP boundaries are explicitly defined with in-scope and out-of-scope lists

evals.prompt: Conduct feasibility analysis and MoSCoW prioritization for a real-time collaborative whiteboard app.
evals.expected_output: The agent categorizes features into Must, Should, Could, and Won't-have buckets, assessing technical constraints.
expectations: Technical feasibility and operational risks documented
